classification.difficultyReason: Read two points from the graph, calculate a decimal gradient of 2.5, then find the intercept from a point. This is slightly more demanding than slot-2 because the gradient is not a whole number.

content.prompt:
A farmer recorded the volume ($V$), in litres, of water in a trough after different filling times ($t$), in minutes, from 4 to 12.

The farmer created a scatterplot and constructed a line of best fit to model the relationship between the filling time and the volume of water.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{50-30}{12-4}\\&=2.5\end{aligned}$$
The units of the gradient are litres per minute.
